title: Ordinary tensor support for native open extension on the sequence site
statement: Fix a prime ell and a finite extension E of Q_ell, and an open immersion j:X -> Z of schemes in universe u. For any ordinary module M on the positive-quotient coefficient sequence site of X and any ordinary module N on that of Z, the ordinary sheaf tensor j_! M tensor N belongs to the essential image of the actual native VaryingRing.extension functor, using the coefficient rings of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], the positive-quotient levels and transitions of [def-weil-compact-support-native-system-evaluation], the native operations of [def-sp-varying-ring-operations], and the ordinary tensor of [def-coef-semilinear-system-models]. This asserts only essential-image membership for ordinary modules: it asserts no normalized morphism, no restriction tensorator, no cochain comparison and no preservation of flatness.

source.place: Tag 0E8I, lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor; its extension to a sheaf-localization is explained in the following remark-j-shriek-tensor.

proof.text: Apply the native ordinary counit-isomorphism step to the tensor object. The counit is an isomorphism, so the tensor is isomorphic to the image of its restriction under native open extension.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0E8I, isolated ordinary essential-image clause of the system-existence proof. Direct-sum and balanced-tensor maps give quotient compatibility on the vertical sequence site.

mathlib_searches.query: The tensor product with a sheaf of modules extended by zero from an open immersion belongs to the essential image of extension by zero
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor, restrict, restrictAdjunction and its left-adjoint instance; four light-condensed monoidal/projectivity results. None is native ordinary extension support.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Scheme.Modules uses the structure sheaf on the small Zariski site, rather than arbitrary positive-quotient rings on the pro-etale sequence site. No matching support theorem.
Used to turn this support clause into invertibility in the parent; does not prove support.

mathlib_searches.results: Six Mathlib hits, all about Cartesian essential-image subcategories or Day convolution; no module extension by zero support result.
mathlib_searches.verdict: The localized project tensor formula supplies the plan; native ordinary support remains to be transported.

from.place: The ordinary support portion of step 3 of lem-coef-native-open-tensor-system-existence, before normalization and totalization.

lean.statement:
theorem nativeOpenTensor_ordinary_supported {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Z)
    [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (M : coefficientSequenceModules.{u, u} l E X)
    (N : coefficientSequenceModules.{u, u} l E Z) :
    (ProEtale.VaryingRing.extension (compactSupportSystemLevel l E)
      (compactSupportSystemQuotient l E) j).essImage
        (ordinaryTensor.{u + 1, u, u} (coefficientSequenceTopology (ProEt.topology Z))
          (coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf.{u, u} l E Z)
          ((ProEtale.VaryingRing.extension (compactSupportSystemLevel l E)
            (compactSupportSystemQuotient l E) j).obj M) N)
